limits: Authored synthetic observations and proposed probes only; no actual-world outcome or mechanism efficacy was measured. Novelty is local to this incomplete frozen archive.

All 35 raw opening IDs are assessed. A primary family is assigned per ID; substantive secondary families are identified in reasons. Automatic all-layout encoding lacks a specified causal implementation and is not counted as a separate intelligible mechanism.

D2-P007, D2-P002 and D2-P004 retain Q output_contract_validation with validation_errors=['fit enum'] and D not_executed_dependency_failed. Readable raw content remains assessable; null post outputs establish neither zero novelty nor successful workflow completion.

Fit assesses commitments and bounded next actions, not empirical success. Mere feasibility conditions do not explicitly relax a hard premise and therefore are not coded conditional. No definite hard-constraint contradiction is established.

No new intelligible family originates only in Distill. Distill's failed-stage absences are not repaired. Successful outputs recommend bounded screening and gate adoption; uncertain production feasibility is not treated as an unconditional usable implementation.

Small samples, possible participant learning, shared sample/time budgets and unspecified production costs prevent certification of the 60-order targets. Blinding guesses remain null; no method identity was sought.
